title: Priority claim: matchings of the period-3 pendant ladder - a mod-3 interlacing recurrence and explicit modular residue tables, Lean 4 formalized (AI4Math pipeline)
description: Priority claim of record (not a full paper). Contents: the claim note (LaTeX source + PDF), the Lean 4 sources (Lean v4.34.0, mathlib4 v4.34.0 rev 5ed29652; 0 sorry; #print axioms whitelist-checked) and the audit and novelty-search evidence. Results: the sequence ap3 counts all matchings of the period-3 pendant ladder at the conjecture layer (the ladder graph P_n x K_2 with one pendant leaf attached to the upper-rail vertex of every column 3k+1, empty matching included); the kernel layer proves three exact laws of the recurrence-defined sequence ap3 (ap3 n = a(n+1)): (1) ap3_interleave, the mod-3 interlacing identity - the order-12 sparse recurrence ap3(n+12) = 45 ap3(n+9) + 63 ap3(n+6) + 11 ap3(n+3) - ap3(n) decouples into three order-4 subsequences bp0/bp1/bp2 sharing the coefficient vector (45, 63, 11, -1), interlaced by n mod 3; (2) ap3_mod2_period15, an explicit period-15 residue table for ap3 mod 2 (odd exactly when n mod 15 is in {0,1,5,6,8,13}); (3) ap3_mod4_period30, an explicit period-30 residue table for ap3 mod 4. All three compile with no sorry; #print axioms for the three is [propext, Quot.sound], [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] x2 (whitelist subsets). The combinatorial identification of ap3 with the matching count is a numerically supported conjecture layer (five methodologically distinct counting implementations agreeing over 241 terms; double-window modular scans), not kernel-proved, and is not claimed as a theorem. Novelty adjudication, copied from the pipeline's two-stage C9 exclusivity review included here in full with every zero-hit query (proposition-level first review over six channels with positive controls; red-team second review with an independent fourth counting implementation, shifted/deep/tail windows, MSE in-site and MathOverflow sweeps, zbMATH full-record read of Farrell 1978, and OEIS reverse cross-reference hunting): no occupying record found for the sequence, its recurrence, or its three mod-3 subsequences; the registered relatives are the plain ladder A030186, the period-1 pendant corona A102436 and the period-2 pendant A386889 (all delimited, none is this object); value tier = new sequence / new recurrence, never new mathematics. Boundaries stated in the note: period minimality (15/30), the period-39/period-60 modular laws, the pure-period existence statement, and the perfect-matching subsequence are numerically observed or not searched, and none is kernel-proved or claimed.
